```{python}
import spatialdata as sd
from spatialdata_io import xenium

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

import scanpy as sc
import squidpy as sq

import pandas
import anndata

pandas.options.mode.string_storage = "python"
anndata.settings.allow_write_nullable_strings = True
```

```{python}
sdata = sd.read_zarr(xenium_zarr)
sdata
```


```{python}
adata = sdata.tables["table"]
adata
```


```{python}
adata.obs
```


```{python}
adata.obsm["spatial"]
```


```{python}
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(adata, percent_top=(10, 20, 50, 150), inplace=True)
```


```{python}
cprobes = (
    adata.obs["control_probe_counts"].sum() / adata.obs["total_counts"].sum() * 100
)
cwords = (
    adata.obs["control_codeword_counts"].sum() / adata.obs["total_counts"].sum() * 100
)
print(f"Negative DNA probe count % : {cprobes}")
print(f"Negative decoding count % : {cwords}")
```


```{python}
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(15, 4))

axs[0].set_title("Total transcripts per cell")
sns.histplot(
    adata.obs["total_counts"],
    kde=False,
    ax=axs[0],
)

axs[1].set_title("Unique transcripts per cell")
sns.histplot(
    adata.obs["n_genes_by_counts"],
    kde=False,
    ax=axs[1],
)


axs[2].set_title("Area of segmented cells")
sns.histplot(
    adata.obs["cell_area"],
    kde=False,
    ax=axs[2],
)

axs[3].set_title("Nucleus ratio")
sns.histplot(
    adata.obs["nucleus_area"] / adata.obs["cell_area"],
    kde=False,
    ax=axs[3],
)
```


```{python}
sc.pp.filter_cells(adata, min_counts=10)
sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_cells=5)
```


```{python}
adata.layers["counts"] = adata.X.copy()
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, inplace=True)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata)
sc.pp.pca(adata)
sc.pp.neighbors(adata)
sc.tl.umap(adata)
sc.tl.leiden(adata)
```


```{python}
sc.pl.umap(
    adata,
    color=[
        "total_counts",
        "n_genes_by_counts",
        "leiden",
    ],
    wspace=0.4,
)
```


```{python}
sq.pl.spatial_scatter(
    adata,
    library_id="spatial",
    shape=None,
    color=[
        "leiden",
    ],
    wspace=0.4,
)
```


```{python}
sq.gr.spatial_neighbors(adata, coord_type="generic", delaunay=True)
```


```{python}
sq.gr.centrality_scores(adata, cluster_key="leiden")
```


```{python}
sq.pl.centrality_scores(adata, cluster_key="leiden", figsize=(16, 5))
```


```{python}
sdata.tables["subsample"] = sc.pp.subsample(adata, fraction=0.5, copy=True)
```


```{python}
adata_subsample = sdata.tables["subsample"]
```


```{python}
sq.gr.co_occurrence(
    adata_subsample,
    cluster_key="leiden",
)
sq.pl.co_occurrence(
    adata_subsample,
    cluster_key="leiden",
    figsize=(10, 10),
)
sq.pl.spatial_scatter(
       adata_subsample,
    color="leiden",
    shape=None,
    size=2,
)
```


```{python}
sq.gr.nhood_enrichment(adata, cluster_key="leiden")
```


```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 7))
sq.pl.nhood_enrichment(
    adata,
    cluster_key="leiden",
    figsize=(8, 8),
    title="Neighborhood enrichment adata",
    ax=ax[0],
)
sq.pl.spatial_scatter(adata_subsample, color="leiden", shape=None, size=2, ax=ax[1])
```


```{python}
sq.gr.spatial_neighbors(adata_subsample, coord_type="generic", delaunay=True)
sq.gr.spatial_autocorr(
    adata_subsample,
    genes=adata.var_names[adata.var["highly_variable"]].tolist(),
    mode="moran",
    n_perms=100,
    n_jobs=1,
)
adata_subsample.uns["moranI"].head(10)
```

```{python}
sq.pl.spatial_scatter(
    adata_subsample,
    library_id="spatial",
    color=[
        "ESCO2",
        "IGFBP5",
    ],
    shape=None,
    size=2,
    img=False,
)
```

```{python}
import spatialdata_plot

gene_name = ["ESCO2", "IGFBP5"]
for name in gene_name:
    sdata.pl.render_images("morphology_focus").pl.render_shapes(
        "cell_circles",
        color=name,
        table_name="table",
        use_raw=False,
    ).pl.show(
        title=f"{name} expression over Morphology image",
        coordinate_systems="global",
        figsize=(10, 5),
    )
```
